title: Chang Hsun

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
318
4/5/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
8th May 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels have demanded $1,000,000 from the Opium Guild in Shanghai. It is said that the opium merchants have promised financial support, provided the rebels guarantee that they will not be approached in future. The amount which the opium merchants are prepared to give is not known, but it is not nearly so much as requested.
With reference to the report of 6th instant saying that General Chang Hsun 張勳 had placed 5,000 troops at the disposal of ex-Governor Chu 朱 to enable him to reconquer Chekiang, General Yang has received instructions from Nanking to remain neutral should fighting take place in Chekiang.
Owing to reports that the gunners at Woosung had been bought over by the rebels, twenty men were transferred from the Arsenal on 7th instant to replace some of the gunners there, who are being transferred to Shanghai.
Eight alleged rebels were arrested in Chapei on 7th instant. They are natives of Hunan and Hupeh:-
Sung Foh Kau 沈福高, Zoo Ching San 徐廣山, Tan Bih Ts
Zau Lau Er 陳表二, Zau Er Laung 曹二郎,
Tan Er Laung 戴二郎, Tsang Da 张大 Li Ping Hyien 李炳義
Two alleged rebels named Too Yong Fei 胡永飛 and
Koo Kyih Sun 顧吉生 were arrested at the S.N.R. yesterday.
About 100 Japanese undesirables, who have been repatriated, left here by the "Omi Maru" on 6th instant.
These are the men referred to in the report of 6th instant.

Your obedient servant,
MB Mcw... (签名)
For Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
318
16/5/4
上海工部局。
1916年5月8日。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

据报，上海叛乱分子向上海鸦片公会索要100万美元。据悉，鸦片商人已承诺提供财政支持，条件是叛乱分子保证今后不再骚扰他们。鸦片商人准备支付的金额尚不清楚，但远少于所要求的数额。

关于本月6日报告中提及张勋将军拨出5,000名士兵供前督军朱氏支配，以助其收复浙江一事，杨将军已接到南京方面的指示，若浙江发生战事，须保持中立。

由于有报告称吴淞的炮手已被叛乱分子收买，兵工厂于本月7日调派二十人前往替换部分炮手，这些被替换的炮手正被调往上海。

本月7日在闸北逮捕了八名涉嫌叛乱分子。他们是湖南和湖北籍人士：-
沈福高 (Sung Foh Kau)，徐廣山 (Zoo Ching San)，Tan Bih Ts（原文不清）
陳表二 (Zau Lau Er)，曹二郎 (Zau Er Laung)，
戴二郎 (Tan Er Laung)，张大 (Tsang Da) 李炳義 (Li Ping Hyien)

两名涉嫌叛乱分子胡永飛 (Too Yong Fei) 和
顧吉生 (Koo Kyih Sun) 昨日在南火车站被捕。

约100名被遣返的日本不良分子于本月6日乘坐“近江丸”号 (Omi Maru) 离开此地。
这些人即为本月6日报告中提及的人员。

您忠实的仆人，
MB Mcw... (签名)
代首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监
